summary: Frontend-only regression after black-theme re-skin (login/register, global bg, sidebar) + dark wizard on /wallet/bank-withdrawal. Login OK on black bg with city watermark image (via AuthBackground.jsx — unchanged). After login the entire app renders on pure black (#000000 rgb 2,6,23 from tailwind bg-slate-950 on body) with the LIONSBIT lion watermark visible (screen mixBlendMode, opacity 0.07) and the blue radial glows. Navigated /dashboard, /messages, /status, /admin, /admin/users — no low-contrast text detected (JS contrast scan only flagged the <title> tag, not visible), no black-on-black or white-on-white regions, layouts intact. Wizard steps 1→2→3 all render dark: inputs bg-slate-950 with white text, selects visible and options readable when expanded, resumen card readable with green total, initiate button works and lands on step 3 with masked email, referencia, wd-resend-code-btn present, code input dark. History tab shows the existing awaiting_code retiro; detail modal opens with dark timeline and awaiting_code amber section including wd-detail-code-input and inline resend button — all legible. Resend email actually succeeded this run (wd-email-failed-warning did NOT appear), so quota is currently OK; the warning branch was verified previously in iter69. Test data (WD-260824-C7CE69 / Test Dark QA / 10 EUR) fully cleaned up: bank_withdrawal_requests deleted, pending.EUR decremented on wallet, associated case deleted. Only two issues found — both cosmetic/low priority (one pre-existing).

ui_bugs.issue: The step-3 back button uses <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1"> without any dark-theme override, so it renders with the shadcn default light background and near-invisible text on the black card. In the screenshot the button area shows an almost-blank white-ish rectangle. Step-2 'Volver' was retuned (border-slate-600 text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800) but step-3 was missed.

Pre-existing (iter69) React hydration warning: dev-time wrapper injects <span> inside <select>/<option>. Cosmetic only, but pollutes the console with two errors on the country and from-currency selects.

issues: Background is not literal pure black — it uses AuthBackground.jsx which renders a city photo with heavy dark overlay. The form is fully legible and this matches the pre-existing auth pages, but if the requirement is 'fondo negro' matching the rest of the app, consider replacing AuthBackground with AppBackground (lion watermark) for visual consistency. NOT a bug per se, task states LoginPage.jsx bg-black — which is set — the image is layered on top via AuthBackground component that was not part of the requested files.

action_items: Give the step-3 'Cancelar' button (wd-back-step3) the same dark-theme classes as step-2 'Volver': variant='outline' className='flex-1 border-slate-600 text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800'.

Optional consistency: decide whether /login and /register should use AppBackground (lion watermark on black) instead of AuthBackground (city photo) so all screens share the same 'negro completo + león' look described in the request.
Optional cleanup (from iter69): remove the ve-dynamic <span> wrappers around <option> content to silence hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: AppBackground.jsx correctly uses #000000 base + mixBlendMode:'screen' opacity 0.07 lion + soft blue glows — good, watermark stays subtle and does not hurt legibility.
BankWithdrawalPage.jsx wizard consistently uses bg-slate-950 inputs / border-slate-700 / text-white — high contrast throughout steps 1, 2, 3 and detail modal. Only wd-back-step3 was overlooked.
Layout/Sidebar switched to #000000/#050505 — sidebar text (slate-200/300) is legible on the near-black surface; icons visible.
No new backend changes were requested or found; API contract intact (accounts, config, list, initiate, resend-code, confirm-code).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all TEST 1-5 passed; 1 medium contrast bug on wd-back-step3, 1 pre-existing low console warning)

Resend quota appeared healthy this run (email_sent=true, no wd-email-failed-warning). Only visible regression from the dark-theme pass is the step-3 'Cancelar' button — same fix pattern already applied to step-2 'Volver'.
rca of the issue: The BankWithdrawalPage retheme touched every field and both Volver/Enviar buttons of step-2 with dark-theme utility classes, but the step-3 Cancelar Button (line ~336) was left with only `flex-1` and no border/text override, so it inherits shadcn's outline defaults (light bg + dark text) — near-invisible on the black card. Fix: mirror step-2: className='flex-1 border-slate-600 text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-800'.
